name: NetScope
author: frig
description: LAN reconnaissance for Omarchy: local IPs per interface, public IP, Wi-Fi and IPv6 context, and every device on the network with its vendor and guessed type. Probe any host's TCP ports, get a security-posture score, and run an AI investigation of a device or the whole network. Continuous monitoring names devices and alerts on new arrivals; export reports and drive it from a bar widget, a window, or a terminal UI. Developed for and by frig.

barWidget.description: Interfaces, public IP, Wi-Fi and the last LAN sweep at a glance, with an unknown-device count; opens the NetScope window or runs a sweep.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Which glyph to show in the bar. access-point and radar sit lowest.

schema.label: Tint icon on unknown device
schema.description: When on, the bar icon turns urgent while an untrusted device is present. Off means the icon always follows the theme.

schema.label: Status poll (seconds)
schema.description: How often the popout refreshes interfaces and the cached public address while open.

schema.label: Sweep on open
schema.description: Run a LAN sweep in the background every time the popout opens.
